question.jcr:title: How can I create and distribute Adobe FrameMaker package through Adobe Admin Console?

answer.text: There are pre-defined templates that are available in the Admin Console to create packages for Adobe FrameMaker. For more details, see Adobe Templates for Packages.

question.jcr:title: Why do I get the missing Distiller error on saving a document as PDF?

answer.text: The Distiller application bundled with the installer needs Visual C runtime libraries to install and run. Sometimes, the Distiller application does not recognize the Visual C runtime libraries even if they are installed on your system. This failure to detect the Visual C runtimes causes the installation of PDF Creation Add-on to fail. A workaround for this issue is available in the Missing Distiller error on saving a document as PDF article.

question.jcr:title: Can I import Microsoft Word files?

answer.text: Yes! Learn how to smoothly import a Word document in this brief tutorial. You can also follow these step-by-step instructions to import Word files.

question.jcr:title: Why can’t I generate a PDF for my FrameMaker document or book file?

answer.text: There could be multiple reasons for this failure. See the Cannot generate PDF of FrameMaker documents or books article for solutions.

question.jcr:title: How to use MIF Wash Utility in FrameMaker?

answer.text: FrameMaker includes the MIF Wash Utility to batch-convert book files, suppress missing font or image warnings, and repair corrupted files. See the How to use MIF Wash Utility in FrameMaker article for setup and usage instructions.

question.jcr:title: Can I buy a full / Perpetual license (with serial key) of the latest release of Adobe FrameMaker?

answer.text:
Full license of Adobe FrameMaker is no longer available for purchase. For individual needs, you can opt for subscription plans via adobe.com.

For enterprises, SMBs, Education and Government segments, one can opt for volume licensing plans like Enterprise Term License Agreement (ETLA) and Value Incentive Program (VIP).

To explore all the buying options, visit the Buying guide page or write to us at techcomm@adobe.com. For more information, view the FrameMaker FAQ.
Learn how to resolve download issues with FrameMaker and other Adobe apps.

question.jcr:title: How do I purchase and install FrameMaker?

answer.text: You can buy FrameMaker through the online Adobe Store or by calling: +1-866-647-1213. Learn about other ways to buy FrameMaker, including buying directly from Adobe or through authorized resellers or purchasing with education discounts. You'll need to sign in with an Adobe ID and password to complete the purchase and download the product. For help downloading and installing the app after purchase, view Find downloaded apps and files.

question.jcr:title: How do I retrieve my Adobe ID or password?

answer.text: Read these simple solutions to common Adobe ID and sign in issues to regain access to your account.

question.jcr:title: FrameMaker launches in a different locale. Why can't I install FrameMaker in multiple locales on the same system?

answer.text:
FrameMaker does not support installation in multiple locales on the same system. If you have installed FrameMaker in multiple locales, it may launch in a locale different from your intended preference. To resolve the issue:

  1. Uninstall FrameMaker.
  2. Download and install FrameMaker in your required locale.

question.jcr:title: How can I change my password?

answer.text: Sign in to your Adobe account. Under the Password section, select Change for Current Password, and then follow the onscreen instructions. Forgot your password? Learn how to reset it.

question.jcr:title: How can I change my credit card info?

answer.text: You can update your credit card information from your accounts page on adobe.com. For more information, view Payment in the Adobe Store | Online order and payment FAQ.

question.jcr:title: My trial expires soon. How do I convert it?

answer.text: You can convert the 30-day trial version of Adobe FrameMaker into a subscription by purchasing a license from Adobe.com. For any queries, you can reach us at techcomm@adobe.com. For more information, see Subscription information and pricing in the FrameMaker FAQ.

question.jcr:title: How do I cancel my subscription? Can I still use the software I have?

answer.text: You can cancel your subscription by contacting Adobe Support. If you cancel within 14 days, you receive a full refund. Otherwise, you are billed 50% of your remaining contract obligation. You will not have access to your subscription software after you cancel. For more information, view Subscription information and pricing in the FrameMaker FAQ.

question.jcr:title: How can I manage my licenses if they are allocated through my organization?

answer.text: You can get in touch with your Administrator who manages licenses for your organization. In case you need more assistance, then you can raise a ticket in the Admin Console by your Administrator.
